paper.title_en: Medium Separation Scheme and the Cold‐Magnetized Superconducting Quark Matter
paper.abstract_en:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We investigate dense quark matter in the two‐flavor color‐superconducting (2SC) phase under a uniform external magnetic field, focusing on the Medium Separation Scheme (MSS) and the Magnetic Field Independent Regularization (MFIR). Within the Nambu–Jona‐Lasinio model, we compare the combined MFIR+MSS framework with alternative smooth‐cutoff prescriptions for the regularization of ultraviolet divergences. We analyze the dependence of the superconducting gap and constituent quark mass on density and magnetic‐field strength. The results show that a consistent separation of vacuum and medium contributions is essential for a reliable description of magnetized dense matter, suppressing spurious oscillatory behavior often misidentified as de Haas–van Alphen–like effects.</jats:p>
